text:
maria: Heads-up: AcmePipeline returning intermittent 504s since 02:10 UTC. CS escalated, customer on Dedicated. Requesting owners and a rollback plan. I can triage logs if someone pairs.

sre-bot: Alert: 504 spike detected in acme-pipeline-prod (p99 1.2s -> 12.6s). Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/example/PD-2345. PagerDuty: PD-2345

jon: I'm on it, checking routing and recent deploy diffs. @maria can you paste the exact requestIDs from the CS thread?

maria: Copied a couple: req-8f3a, req-8f3b. Also seeing high token backpressure in gateway logs and repeated `kv_get` timeouts.

devex-jen: Looks like the canary rolled at 01:58 — we changed KV cache TTL and bumped `batch_size`. Reverting the batch_size bump is low-risk. PR reference: #4582. Suggest command to rollback if needed: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/acme-pipeline --to-revision=3`

ops-rahul: Ops can trigger rollback, but need eng-platform signoff. @jon @devex-jen confirm that rolling back batch_size will remove the backpressure symptoms. If not, we can scale another pool as fallback.

jon: Rolling back batch_size only is plausible fix. I'll cut a hotfix PR now (small diff). ETA ~20m for PR + ~10m for deploy if approved.

maria: :thumbsup: Please proceed. Also request temporary routing fallback — route Acme traffic to backup pool `pool-b` when latency > 5s. Can ops add that policy?

ops-rahul: Opening routing override in control plane: `route overwrite acme -> pool-b if latency>5s`. This is manual and will be applied now.

jon: PR created: #4601 with rollback change. Pinged @devex-jen for fast review.

devex-jen: Reviewed & approved. CI green. Deploying hotfix now: `deploy hotfix acme-pipeline --rev=rollback-batch`

sre-bot: Deploy started for acme-pipeline hotfix. 🚀 build: b6690; expected rollout ~6m.

maria: Thanks — CS updated the customer and asked for MTTR estimate. Please call it 30m and update if we miss it. Keep me posted on progress and any SLA risk flags.

ops-rahul: Routing override in place. Observability alert muted for noise. Pool-b receiving ~12% traffic as a safety buffer.

sre-bot: Metrics update: latency p50 220ms -> 190ms; error rate 8% -> 1.2% (since override + deploy).

jon: Hotfix completed and rolled out. 504s subsided for the last 8m. Merged #4601. Recommend keeping routing override for 1h then revert.

maria: Agreed. Action items: 1) if we hit SLA window, file postmortem; 2) deep-dive KV caching impact on batch_size; 3) add canary gating for batch_size changes. I'll open a follow-up ticket and tag owners. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/IN-789

ops-rahul: ✅ Will revert routing override after 1h. Tagging #incidents for a sync at 15:00 UTC to review.

sre-bot: Final check: no new 504s in past 12m, p99 trimmed from 12.6s -> 1.1s. Monitoring will stay open for 2 hours.
